title.en: Legislative Analyst's analysis of Proposition 4, Official Voter Information Guide
Attorney General's title and summary of Proposition 4, with the Analyst's fiscal estimate, Official Voter Information Guide

explanation.en: The Analyst says Proposition 4 "does not create a public campaign finance system for the state or local governments directly" and only allows them to create programs in the future. The Analyst adds that the option is open to the state as well as local governments.

description.en: Official Voter Information Guide, argument in favor of Proposition 4

sourceTitle.en: Official Voter Information Guide, November 3, 2026 General Election: arguments and rebuttals on Proposition 4

speaker.en: Official argument in favor of Proposition 4

text: Proposition 4 does not create a public financing program. It simply gives local governments the option to adopt one if they choose.
